settings.title: FULL-SPECTRUM REVENUE CYCLE MANAGEMENT

settings.editor: Whether you need end-to-end medical billing, targeted insurance denial recovery, or practice workflow modernization, StelleMed provides the certified expertise and technology to optimize your clinical cash flow.

settings.title: Three Pillars of Revenue Cycle Excellence

settings.editor: Each pillar is designed to seamlessly integrate with your existing workflow, relieving clinical staff and maximizing collections.

settings.title: END-TO-END THIRD-PARTY PAYER COLLECTIONS FOR HEALTHCARE PROVIDERS

settings.editor: We manage your entire payer billing cycle from initial eligibility checking to clean claim submission, aggressive denial appeals, and aging A/R recovery.

icon_list.text: Real-time 270/271 eligibility checking within 15 seconds prior to service
Certified AAPC/AHIMA medical coding & routine accuracy audits
Automated CMS-1500 and UB-04 EDI submission with 24-48 hr turnaround
Clinical appeals written for complex A/R denials and aging revenue

settings.title: TRANSPARENT PATIENT FINANCIAL COUNSELING AND OUT-OF-POCKET RESOLUTION

settings.editor: Patient responsibility is an increasing percentage of practice revenue. We make payment transparent, accessible, and compliant with No Surprises Act regulations.

icon_list.text: No Surprises Act compliant Good Faith Estimates (GFE)
Omni-channel patient billing via SMS, email, and paper statements
Point-of-service payment collection tools and digital checkout
Dedicated patient billing support team for courteous financial resolution

settings.title: CLOUD AUTOMATION, ADVANCED TOOLS, AND SEAMLESS EHR & EMR ARCHITECTURE

settings.editor: Modern revenue cycle management requires modern tech. StelleMed integrates directly into your existing EHR/EMR or provides custom automations to eliminate friction.

icon_list.text: Direct API & HL7/FHIR integrations with Epic, Cerner, AthenaHealth, and 50+ EHRs
StelleCloud clearinghouse engine with real-time scrub & 24hr rejection resolution
Business intelligence dashboards with key RCM KPIs updated daily
Dedicated IT & engineering team ensuring continuous uptime & data security

settings.editor: Every medical discipline operates under unique payer guidelines, documentation hurdles, and fee schedules. Our certified billing teams have dedicated specialty pods.
Complex multi-code visits, preventive wellness (AWV), chronic care management (CCM).
Cath lab interventions, echocardiography, nuclear imaging, and modifier 25/59 optimization.
Surgical bundles, implant billing, DME pre-authorizations, and physical therapy cross-overs.
Psychotherapy, IOP, medication management, and specialized telehealth coding rules.
Vaccine administration bundles, developmental screenings, and Medicaid managed care plans.
ASC billing, anesthesia coordination, pre-op clearance, and high-dollar claim appeals.
High-volume rapid charge capture, same-day verification, and occupational medicine billing.
Timed 8-minute rule calculations, functional progress reporting, and plan-of-care caps.

settings.title: Need a Customized Revenue Cycle Plan for Your Clinic?

settings.editor: We evaluate your existing billing drift, EHR software, and monthly claim volume to create a hybrid or fully managed RCM strategy.
